title: High CPU on Azure VM
keywords: cpu high process iis worker batch
steps: Check Azure Monitor CPU metric for last 1 hour
RDP/Bastion to VM and identify top process in Task Manager
If IIS worker: recycle the application pool (not the whole server)
Monitor CPU for 15 minutes
If still above 90%, escalate to L2 and consider scale-up via change request

title: Low disk space on VM
keywords: disk full space storage logs drive
steps: Check free space in Azure Monitor / Log Analytics
Run Disk Cleanup and clear temp folders
Archive IIS/app logs older than 30 days to storage account
Confirm free space above 20%
Raise problem ticket to enable log rotation

title: Expired TLS certificate on Application Gateway
keywords: certificate tls ssl expired 502 gateway probe key vault
steps: Confirm certificate expiry date in Key Vault
Renew or import the new certificate in Key Vault
Update Application Gateway listener to new certificate version
Verify backend health probe is Healthy
Test website and close incident

title: Azure SQL performance degradation
keywords: sql database slow dtu blocking query index
steps: Check DTU/CPU in Azure portal and Query Performance Insight
Identify blocking session (sys.dm_exec_requests)
Inform DBA; kill blocking session only with DBA approval
Apply recommended index through change request
Monitor DTU for 30 minutes
